findings.issue: Changes to deployment workflows and infra/terraform can be applied without human approval — no required reviewers on deploy jobs
findings.impact: Critical deployment/infra changes can reach production without review, violating approval gate requirements
findings.fix: Add environment: production with required reviewers; add CODEOWNERS for infra/ and .github/workflows/

findings.issue: Single SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF for both dev and prod — no separate Supabase project per environment
findings.impact: Migrations from develop directly affect same database as main
findings.fix: Use separate Supabase projects with separate project ref secrets per environment

findings.issue: E2E tests all marked test.skip — zero E2E coverage despite having 48 test stubs and Playwright configured
findings.impact: No E2E baseline before edits; cannot detect UI regression during reconciliation
findings.fix: Establish at minimum auth and workspace E2E tests as baseline before reconciliation edits

findings.issue: SMTP/email env vars not set in any deployment workflow — SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS, EMAIL_FROM all missing
findings.impact: Password reset and transactional emails non-functional in deployed environments
findings.fix: Add SMTP configuration secrets to all deploy workflows

findings.issue: Multiple .env.example files exist across apps with inconsistent variable coverage — no single source of truth for required env vars
findings.impact: New environment setup requires cross-referencing multiple files; missing vars not caught until runtime
findings.fix: Consolidate to root .env.example as canonical source; validate all vars documented

findings.issue: No Terraform plan step in deploy workflows — terraform apply runs without plan review
findings.impact: Infrastructure changes applied without human review of planned changes
findings.fix: Add terraform plan step with approval gate before apply

findings.issue: No explicit CODEOWNERS file defining required reviewers for sensitive paths
findings.impact: Anyone can modify auth, DB, infra, or deployment files without specialized review
findings.fix: Create CODEOWNERS: @MaineCyberTech/security for auth/supabase/, @MaineCyberTech/infra for terraform/, @MaineCyberTech/ops for deploy workflows

findings.issue: Worker package has no test script configured in package.json
findings.impact: Worker code changes during reconciliation have zero test coverage
findings.fix: Add vitest config and test script to apps/worker/package.json

findings.issue: No checkpoint branch created before reconciliation — no git tag marking pre-reconciliation state
findings.impact: Cannot easily revert to pre-reconciliation state if edits cause issues
findings.fix: Create git tag pre-reconciliation-baseline before any reconciliation edits

findings.issue: No baseline captured for lint/typecheck/test pass before reconciliation edits
findings.impact: Cannot distinguish pre-existing failures from reconciliation-introduced issues
findings.fix: Run and capture pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test output as baseline artifact

findings.issue: Playwright test results (.playwright-results/) and generated coverage reports not gitignored
findings.impact: Generated artifacts may be committed during reconciliation file passes

findings.issue: No explicit documentation of which files/folders are off-limits during reconciliation
findings.impact: Reconciliation AI may modify critical config files without understanding impact
findings.fix: Document off-limits paths: apps/api/src/config/, supabase/migrations/, infra/terraform/, .github/workflows/deploy-*
